div.div: From the docs.officely.app API reference. Non-bookable Spaces (building, level, zone, room, car park, kitchen) are kept separate from bookable Resources, all under a Place. Floor plans are versioned JSON documents (floor-manifest/1) that publish Spaces and Resources. Officely for Slack/Teams has only a read-only reporting API and is not shown.
